comment: Hands-down the best professor I've ever had and probably the smartest person I've ever met. Do NOT pass up the opportunity to take a class with him.

Incredibly intelligent. Extremely passionate. Deeply caring. I'm honored to have had the opportunity to take a class with him. If you EVER get the chance to, DO NOT PASS IT UP. You will not regret it.
Kuswa is a stellar professor who truly cares about each and every one of his students who show interest in his classes.
He is by far the best teacher at Richmond!!! Take any class he teaches!
one of the best profs i've ever had

This guy knows his stuff, and I would argue with anyone on campus as to why this Professor is the hands-down best.  He's one of the smartest people I have ever heard speak and the most helpful professor outside of class I have ever had.  Truly an amazing person
He is a really cool guy and is awesome for helping with any problems, not just in the classroom. He is really funny and really chill about everything. Def. my favorite class!
SO smart and very cool. Awesome guy, very good at what he does and very open to students.
I've taken 3 courses with Dr. Kuswa, and he's great!  He's very accomodating if you need help, low-stress courses, and you actually learn a lot!
